chunks: In the narration of Abū al-Ḥusayn al-Asadī, may Allah be pleased with him, he said: Al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام said:
"Whoever embraces a pilgrim while bearing his dust, it is as though he has touched the Black Stone."

key_terms.الْحَجَرَ الْأَسْوَدَ: the Black Stone in the Kaʿbah
key_terms.بِغُبَارِهِ: with the dust of his journey still upon him
key_terms.حَاجًّا: a person performing or returning from hajj

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for embracing a pilgrim returning from hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith highlights the virtue and honor of the pilgrim and encourages believers to show reverence toward those returning from hajj. Embracing the pilgrim while the dust of the journey remains upon him is described as carrying a reward comparable to touching the Black Stone.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2513 - In a narration by Abu al-Husayn al-Asadi, may Allah (swt) be pleased with him, Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Whoever embraces a pilgrim while the dust of the journey is still on them, it is as if they have touched the Black Stone."
